target triple = "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu"

entry:

  %shuffle24 = shufflevector <16 x i8> %0, <16 x i8> zeroinitializer, <4 x i32> <i32 2, i32 4, i32 9, i32 9>

comments.body: Lack of a topologically sorted DAG strikes again :(

issue.title: [X86] llc crashed at -O0/O1/O2/O3: Cannot select: 0x2656ecd0: v4i32 = BUILD_VECTOR...

patch:
commit 7485f34802f0ea1e00ac69499050e79692609b85
Author: Simon Pilgrim <llvm-dev@redking.me.uk>
Date:   Sun Nov 23 15:04:05 2025 +0000

    [X86] X86ISelDAGToDAG - don't let ADD/SUB(X,1) -> SUB/ADD(X,-1) constant fold (#169217)
    
    Extension to #168726 - ensure we peek through bitcasts to look for
    constants (as constant folding will)
    
    DAG should have constant folded this, but we're still fighting the lack
    of proper topological sorting.
    
    Fixes #169205

diff --git a/llvm/lib/Target/X86/X86ISelDAGToDAG.cpp b/llvm/lib/Target/X86/X86ISelDAGToDAG.cpp
index 2b5a63aa6692..e7903a72d85b 100644
--- a/llvm/lib/Target/X86/X86ISelDAGToDAG.cpp
+++ b/llvm/lib/Target/X86/X86ISelDAGToDAG.cpp
@@ -1004,7 +1004,8 @@ void X86DAGToDAGISel::PreprocessISelDAG() {
     if ((N->getOpcode() == ISD::ADD || N->getOpcode() == ISD::SUB) &&
         N->getSimpleValueType(0).isVector() && !mayPreventLoadFold()) {
       APInt SplatVal;
-      if (!ISD::isBuildVectorOfConstantSDNodes(N->getOperand(0).getNode()) &&
+      if (!ISD::isBuildVectorOfConstantSDNodes(
+              peekThroughBitcasts(N->getOperand(0)).getNode()) &&
           X86::isConstantSplat(N->getOperand(1), SplatVal) &&
           SplatVal.isOne()) {
         SDLoc DL(N);
